theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U A W : Set (Euclid P)) (T Z₁ : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsOpen U → IsMinimizingIn T A → IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → X.boundary = 0 → IsCompact X.support → X.support ⊆ A ∩ W → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), Z₁ ω = T ω + X (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) (m + 1) ω)) → T.massOn W ≤ Z₁.massOn W
